title: Delegating Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents
title_zh: 将地球科学模型校准委托给知识引导型 LLM 智能体

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种通用校准框架，通过知识引导型LLM智能体实现地球科学模型的端到端校准委托。 Applying process-based Earth science models to new sites and questions often requires expert calibration decisions. Reliable delegation to language-model agents must preserve scientific competence and reproducibility. Here we develop a general calibration harness (GCH) for end-to-end delegation from a calibration request to assessed results. Constrained by a knowledge infrastructure (KI) and a validation convention, agents define parameter domains, observation mappings and objectives, and generate model-specific code. GCH checks the formulations against the same declarations and freezes them before numerical search and assessment, which require no further agent judgement. Agent-authored workflows executed across six model families, with assessment identifying unmet criteria. In snow-model tests, five of five knowledge-guided specifications executed on the first attempt, compared with none of five given only the model name, achieving validation Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.81-0.94 against 0.57 for defaults. Under a common objective, independent GR4J formulations yielded scores within 0.001 NSE; re-evaluating eleven saved parameter vectors reproduced their metrics. In ten paired VIC tests with matched budgets, fixed search was non-inferior to continuing agent proposals (margin, -0.02 NSE; median difference, -0.003). This separation enables end-to-end calibration delegation with inspectable scientific choices and reproducible numerical evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种通用校准框架，通过知识引导型LLM智能体实现地球科学模型的端到端校准委托。将基于过程的地球科学模型应用于新地点和新问题时，通常需要专家做出校准决策。 对语言模型智能体的可靠委托必须保留科学能力与可重复性。 在此，我们开发了一种通用校准工具（GCH），用于从校准请求到评估结果的端到端委托。 在知识基础设施（KI）和验证规范的约束下，智能体定义参数域、观测映射和目标，并生成模型特定的代码。 GCH根据相同的声明检查这些公式，并在数值搜索与评估前将其固定，而这两个过程无需智能体进一步判断。 由智能体编写的跨六个模型族的工作流得以执行，评估结果识别出未满足的标准。 在雪模测试中，五种知识引导型规范均首次尝试即成功执行，而仅给定模型名称时则无一成功；与默认设置相比，验证的Nash-Sutcliffe效率（NSE）达到了0.81-0.94，而非0.57。 在共同目标下，独立的GR4J公式产生的NSE分数差异不超过0.001；对十一个已保存的参数向量重新评估，其指标得以重现。 在十组匹配预算的VIC配对测试中，固定搜索方案在效果上不低于持续的智能体提案（差距为-0.02 NSE；中位数差异为-0.003）。 这种分离使得端到端校准委托成为可能，同时确保了科学选择的可检查性与数值评估的可重复性。
